summary: Shaded school-side kerb, homes about 22 m away, but steep.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 21-22 m away on the west side; school grounds and dense trees across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with a few cars parked; room is tight under the canopy.
drivers.traffic: Quiet apart from school drop-off peaks.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but the street has school loading signs and no sign of van stays.

flags: School loading and no-parking times 7-9am and 2-4pm on school days
Dwellings 9-14 m away at other points
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the section; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact sign coverage on this section
